test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: In Indus valley civilization, Lothal was famous for which of the following?
solution:
__
 
• In Indus valley civilization, **Lothal** was famous for its **dockyard__.**
 
• According to the ASI, It had the **world's earliest known dock**, which connected the city to an ancient course of the Sabarmati river on the trade route between Harappan cities in Sindh and the peninsula of Saurashtra
